title: Definition of done: every claim on the page and README points at the file that backs it; no hand-written test counts or runtimes
problem: Claims is the most-failed gate: 89 of 130 below-bar subjects, 46 of 64 sampled ventures. Overclaim (116) and stale-docs (30) are the second-largest defect group; hand-written counts and runtimes go stale on the next change.
evidence: claims gate failures among below-bar subjects: 89 of 130 (python3 platform/ci/quality_audit.py metrics --md, 2026-11-10)
overclaim defects 116, stale-docs 30 (keyword taxonomy, 75% agreement with hand labels)
change: A claims pass in the definition of done: each number or comparative claim links its backing test, result or source, or is cut or labelled an estimate. A check that flags README sentences of the form 'N tests' or 'about N minutes'.
